# --description--

`??` is the shortest way to turn an optional into a plain value when a sensible default exists:
```swift
func volume(from setting: Int?) -> Int {
    return setting ?? 50
}
```

# --instructions--

Write a function `port` with the parameter `from` of type `Int?` that returns the given port, or `8080` when it is `nil`.
Use `??`

# --before-seed--

```swift
// DO NOT EDIT FROM HERE
import Foundation

var _testCount = 0
var _testFailedCount = 0
func tryCatch(_ assertion: Bool) {
    _testCount += 1
    if !assertion {
        _testFailedCount += 1
        print("Test Case '--err-t\(_testCount)--' failed")
    }
}
// DO NOT EDIT UNTIL HERE
```

# --asserts--

`port(from: 3000)` must return `3000`

```swift
tryCatch(port(from: 3000) == 3000)
```

`port(from: nil)` must return `8080`

```swift
tryCatch(port(from: nil) == 8080)
```

`port(from: 443)` must return `443`

```swift
tryCatch(port(from: 443) == 443)
```

# --after-asserts--

```swift
print("Executed \(_testCount) tests, with \(_testFailedCount) failures")
```

# --solutions--

```swift
func port(from setting: Int?) -> Int {
    return setting ?? 8080
}
```
